question: which doctor get the highest appointmnents

output.sql:
SELECT d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name, COUNT(a.appointment_id) AS appointment_count
FROM doctors d
JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name
ORDER BY appointment_count DESC
LIMIT 1
output.summary: Dr. Chanudi Padmasiri (doctor ID 238) has the most appointments of any doctor, with a total of 459. Only this one doctor is in the result, so no comparison with others is shown.
